trailhead.label: The stone bridge at Fondo, Traversella, the board’s start

cautions: The zigzag climb to Tissone is steady: take it slowly with an older dog.
The stream and the waterfall pool near Tallorno are fast and cold: keep your dog out of the current.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.The zigzag climb to Tissone is steady: t: La salita a tornanti fino a Tissone è costante: vai piano con un cane anziano.
textIt.The stream and the waterfall pool near T: Il torrente e la pozza sotto la cascata vicino a Tallorno sono rapidi e freddi: tieni il cane fuori dalla corrente.
